propositions: Cloud encode emits plain-text ADF paragraphs instead of structured ADF; Markdown syntax appears as literal source in Jira Cloud descriptions and comments.
DC wiki markup is identity; Markdown source is not rendered to Jira wiki syntax, and Jira-authored wiki reads back as noise.
Echo loops occur between rebar and Jira; unchanged reconcile passes commit state entries; Jira-native constructs like panels, mentions, and dates are not preserved through round-trip sync.
The existing corpus measurements (5,730 bodies, 99.65% idempotence) are unreproducible; export artifacts and session workspaces have been deleted; live store cardinality is 5,209 bodies, not 5,730.

Bidirectional codec architecture requires state-based echo safety using per-binding ADR-0026 baseline, change-gated rich_sha, and three-way comparison; concurrent edits must be flagged instead of silently overwritten.
